edges.notes: Clang lowers C/C++/Objective-C to LLVM IR for the LLVM middle/back end.
Clang can invoke lld via -fuse-ld=lld and related driver options.
On many GNU/Linux triplets the driver invokes GNU as and GNU ld by default.
Clang compiles ISO C and common C extensions; primary LLVM C compiler.
Clang wasm32-wasi targets link against wasi-libc sysroots in LLVM distributions.
Debug builds emit DWARF (typical on ELF targets) when using -g.
Default object format on Unix-class ELF targets.
clangd implements the Language Server Protocol for C/C++.
Clang and GCC are substitutable C/C++ compilers on many Linux and cross-compile flows.
Clang -g DWARF builds are commonly debugged with GDB on Linux.
LLDB is the LLVM-native debugger paired with Clang in LLVM-centric toolchains.
Clang on GNU/Linux often produces binaries linked against glibc when using the gnu environment.
Clang can target musl with appropriate triplets and sysroots (e.g. Alpine-class environments).
Clang may use GNU libstdc++ when invoked with -stdlib=libstdc++ on supported Linux setups.
Clang links LLVM libc++ when using -stdlib=libc++ in LLVM-oriented C++ builds.
Clang-generated C++ references libc++abi symbols for exceptions, RTTI, and static initialization on Itanium ABI targets.
Clang/LLVM packages may be installed on Alpine for alternative compiler stacks targeting musl.
Clang/LLVM packages are available from Debian archives for alternative compiler stacks on glibc.
Clang/LLVM packages are available from Ubuntu archives for alternative compiler stacks on glibc.
Clang/LLVM packages are available from Fedora repositories for alternative compiler stacks on glibc.
Clang/LLVM toolchains may be installed on RHEL where Red Hat or related repositories offer them.
Clang/LLVM packages may be installed from Rocky Linux repositories where offered.
Clang/LLVM packages may be installed from AlmaLinux repositories where offered.
Clang/LLVM packages may be installed from CentOS Stream repositories where offered.
Clang/LLVM packages could be installed from historical CentOS Linux repositories where offered.
Clang targeting Windows can link MSVC-compatible CRT DLL layouts when using the Windows SDK and MSVC-style linking.
Clang/LLVM toolchains on FreeBSD link against FreeBSD libc in typical ports and base builds.
Clang/LLVM may be used on OpenBSD and link against OpenBSD libc where configured.
Clang/LLVM may be used on NetBSD and link against NetBSD libc where configured.
Clang/LLVM may be used on DragonFly and link against DragonFly libc where configured.
Clang/LLVM may be used on illumos distributions and link against illumos libc where configured.
Clang is the primary NDK compiler and links native code against Bionic for Android targets.
Clang/LLVM embedded toolchains may link against newlib sysroots when configured for bare-metal targets.
